name: nd-rating-sync
description: Reads embedded rating tags from MP3 (ID3v2: FMPS_Rating / POPM iTunes / POPM WMP / TXXX:RATING), FLAC, OGG-Vorbis and Opus (Vorbis comments: FMPS_RATING / RATING) files and syncs them to Navidrome's user ratings via the Subsonic API, with per-user per-library tag priority and overwrite control.
author: Your Name <you@example.com>

libraries.reason: Read music files from all assigned Navidrome libraries to extract embedded rating tags

subsonicapi.reason: Call setRating to write star ratings back into Navidrome per user

users.reason: Required by the subsonicapi permission for per-user authorisation and to scope scrobble/scan events

scheduler.reason: Schedule periodic scans of the music library and handle manual scan trigger requests

sync_schedule.title: Sync schedule (cron expression) [admin]
sync_schedule.description: Cron expression for automatic recurring scans. Examples: '0 */6 * * *' = every 6 hours, '0 2 * * *' = daily at 02:00. Changes take effect after the plugin is reloaded. Only administrators should change this.

user_scan_cooldown_hours.title: User-scan cooldown (hours) [admin]
user_scan_cooldown_hours.description: Minimum number of hours a user must wait between manual scan requests. Set to 0 to disable the cooldown. Only administrators should change this.

max_songs_per_run.title: Max songs per scan [admin]
max_songs_per_run.description: Maximum number of songs to process in a single scheduled run. Set to 0 for no limit.

libraries.title: Library configurations
libraries.description: One entry per Navidrome library. Each entry defines which users are active in that library and their personal rating tag preferences.

libraryId.title: Library ID
libraryId.description: The Navidrome internal ID of the library (visible in the Libraries admin page).

libraryName.title: Library display name
libraryName.description: Human-readable label for your reference only — not used by the plugin at runtime.

users.title: User settings for this library
users.description: One entry per user whose ratings should be processed in this library.

username.title: Navidrome username
username.description: Must match the Navidrome username exactly. Also add this user to 'User Access' in the plugin permissions panel.

trigger_user_scan.title: Trigger scan now
trigger_user_scan.description: Set to true to request an immediate one-time rating scan for this user. The plugin checks for this flag every 15 minutes and resets it automatically once the scan is queued. Subject to the cooldown period configured above.

skip_already_rated.title: Skip already-rated songs
skip_already_rated.description: When true (default), songs that already have a star rating in Navidrome for this user are left untouched. Set to false to allow tag values to overwrite existing ratings.

ratingTagOrder.title: Rating tag priority order
ratingTagOrder.description: Ordered list of embedded tag formats to try when reading a rating from a file. The first tag found in a file wins. Remove formats this user does not use. Supported values: WMP (POPM, MP3 only), iTunes (POPM, MP3 only), MediaMonkey (FMPS_Rating in MP3 TXXX or FLAC/Ogg/Opus Vorbis comments), foobar2000 (RATING in MP3 TXXX or FLAC/Ogg/Opus Vorbis comments, integer 1–5).

ratingTagOrder.ui:description: Only include formats relevant to this user. Order determines priority — first match in the file wins.
